name: Amami Hiroki
source:
A kind, young man who just got employed during the spring season. Has no memories of his father, but knows how he was raised lovingly by his mother Shiori. He loves Shiori more than as a mother, but knows that it isn't right, so he tries to keep his true feelings sealed. Has never dated any woman in his life. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=736393]Getchu[/url]]
